Roger that, all systems show green – SA-14 you're cleared for departure.
Acknowledged, Freeport 7. We'll see you in about two weeks.
Sa-14, we're picking up unknown contacts on long-range sensors. We're dispatching a fighter wing to escort you out of the system. Godspeed.
Navy Command, this is Freeport 7. We're picking up some strange readings on the long-range sensors.
Alert! Unknown ships have breached the defense perimeter. Man all stations!
Incoming! Brace for impact!
[unintelligible screams]

You must be Trent. I'm King, the CO of this mission. I contacted the lead transport of the convoy. They've completed pre-launch checks and are ready to go. Should be an easy run from here to Fort Bush and then on to Pittsburgh. Ready?
Newark Station, this is RNC Donau. Requesting clearance to dock with your station. Over.
Newark, do not interfere! We're here to protect the President. Schultzky is a traitor!
No!
Damn it! They blew up the Donau! Newark, this is LSF Patrol Gamma 6! Engaging enemy!
The Order will pay for this. Escort wing: Fire at will.
LPU Patrol Beta 2! Cleared for alarm start!
That was the last one, Newark.

Hey Trent. Having trouble with your controls? Your HUD is showing the location of the waypoint in several places. A diamond-shaped icon is showing you the direction of the waypoint. You could also check the contact list: it's marked there as Mission Waypoint. Selecting either one will show you direction and distance to the waypoint.

Still having trouble? The easiest way to find where you have to go is by selecting the waypoint. After you select it, you'll either be facing the waypoint or you won't. If you see a bigger diamond, you're still flying in the wrong direction and you have to turn your ship around. If you're facing the correct way, you see the target as a diamond shape with a distance indicator. All you have to do is fly toward that point in space.
Looked like The Order was determined to keep Schultzky from meeting the President. Hard to believe that this could happen. [sigh] We better get going.

Hey, Trent, are you having trouble? You have to select the transport and then use the FORMATION maneuver in your Neural Net. Your navigation computer will automatically get you into a good formation position.
Damn it! Trent, get your weapons ready. This could get rough.
Damn it, Trent. Re-enter formation. We can't wait for you.
We're outta here! Trent, use the Trade Lane to Pittsburgh. Good luck.
We made it! Everybody in one piece?
We made it. Can't believe those damned Rogues got the other transport. Transport leader, you guys still with us?
Can't believe they got the other transport. Transport leader, you guys still with us?
Now it's your turn to reel 'em in, King. We're gonna unload our cargo. Remember our bargain.
What the hell were you doing? Are you crazy? Those Rogues can be dangerous! Anyway, I'm glad you made it. Land on Pittsburgh. I'll meet you on the surface.
Damn it, Trent! The lead transport is down. That's it. We failed.
Damn it, more pirates! Trent, defend the prison ship at all costs.

There you are! Four LSF wings from Fort Bush are searching the debris field for the Rogue base. They've already taken prisoners. I'm uploading the coordinates for our search pattern. We'll rendezvous with another wing of fighters for our patrol. Hold on, there they are.
Gamma 6, Delta patrol reports no hostile contacts.
What are you doing, Trent? We've got to get going. Select one of the Epsilon ships and use the formation maneuver.

After the attack on our transport, the LSF has dispatched four wings to help us track down where these Rogues are coming from. They gotta have a secret base around here and this time... we'll find it.
Mayday! Mayday! This is Prison Ship XT-19, we're under attack. To all Liberty patrols, please respond!
There she is... she's hurt bad... Everyone, break formation and engage.
The Rogue base must be around here. They'd never attack something as big as a prison ship too far away from their hideout.
Mayday! This is LSF Beta 4. I'm under attack and need assistance!
I'm near the edge of the debris field. I– [static]
I have several Rogue ships on my tail– [static] I can't shake 'em! My shields are failing!
My systems are fried and I have a coolant leak. I'm headed back to Pittsburgh.
Let's go. Head to the coordinates.
Trent, I think this is it. I'm gonna call in for some backup.
Incoming Rogue fighters! Get ready!
They're fleeing into the field.
The Rogue base must be in the cloud ahead. Trent, take the lead.
There! The Rogue Base! To all units, this is Gamma 6. We've confirmed the location of the Rogue base. I'm transmitting new coordinates.
Engage the remaining fighters, Trent! We can't let them get away!
Good work, Trent. Let's get clear. I'm uploading coordinates for Pittsburgh to your Neural Net. Let's go.
Great work back there, Trent. Not bad for a rookie!
column5: script and FLSubs say "Good work"; recording says "Great"

column3: What we did here today will hopefully put a dent in the growing crime problem we've been having in this system. Maybe now we can focus our full attention on The Order and anyone who supports them. Schultzky's assassination can't go unpunished.

President Jacobi's ordered a full investigation to determine what can be done about The Order. It'll likely mean more work for us soon. Meanwhile, why don't you spread your wings a bit - familiarize yourself with the New York system, maybe see what work you can pick up. I'll be in touch. Juni out!
column5: kept exactly as typed

column3: Yeah! I'm fine.
I thought he'd lost it, but then these two guys appeared and shot him. Maybe he wasn't just paranoid. Ah, I'm never getting paid. Goodbye, million credits.
We've lost enough time here. We've got a job to do and a schedule to keep. Take the Trade Lane.
That's it. I'll be sure and tell Juni you weren't serious about bringing in Ashcroft. See ya.
This is Juni. Ashcroft has been sighted in the Kepler System. We don't know which way he's going, but it looks like he's coming straight at you. Keep your eyes open. Over.
Hey Trent, we have to get into position. Fly to the waypoint near the Trade Lane.
Got him! I'm going in! Follow me.
Mayday! Mayday! This is Pueblo Station. We're under attack! Repeat: we're under attack!
Yeah! Last one! Pueblo, what's your status?
This is LSF Gamma 6. We found Ashcroft! Need immediate backup. Lock onto my signal. Over.
Damn it! Ashcroft's making a run for it. He activated his cruise engines!
I'm picking up a disturbance – could be a Jump Hole. We have to hurry or he's gonna get away!
Roger that! I'm seeing the same thing. Everybody, get ready!
I'm not Ashcroft, you jar-head. I'm really gonna have your butt.
The name is Cosmo Van Nostrom. Remember it! I'm about to be your worst nightmare, flatfoot. This is wrongful arrest, harassment and wanton destruction of my property.
This is outrageous! You haven't heard the last of this! I– [coughs]
Don't you know how to use a tractor beam? Select Ashcroft's life pod and use the tractor beam in the target window on the left side of your HUD. Come on, we have to get this thug to Juni.
Zeta 1, we're taking Ashcroft back to New York for interrogation. Thanks for your help.
column5: kept exactly as typed

column3: Good job, Trent. Ashcroft's on ice and Juni's waiting for us in New York. I'm uploading a waypoint to the gate. Let's get going.
I hope Ashcroft's interrogation will shed some light on the illegal artifact trade here in Liberty. Pressure from high up has been mounting in the last few weeks.
This is Juni. King, are you and Trent all right? What is your status? Over.
We're fine. Mission accomplished. We broke up Ashcroft's little party. He was getting ready to move those artifacts onto the black market when we took him down.
He'll get what he deserves, but not until he's told us all we need to know. I'll make preparations for your arrival.
Come on, Trent. We've lost enough time already. Take the Jump Gate and use your DOCK maneuver.
This is Patrol Gamma 6 on special assignment. We have a prisoner for the LSF. Requesting permission to proceed. Over.
Acknowledged, Gamma 6. You've received priority clearance. Over.
Thank you, Unity. Out! Juni must have arranged that for us. Let's go.
This is Juni. Change of plans. You and Trent are to proceed directly to the Battleship Missouri near Zone 21. I'll take charge of Ashcroft there. Juni out.
Damn it! Intel was right. More Rogues! Trent, we have to fight them off. Fort Bush, this is LSF Gamma 6! We're under attack and need assistance. Over.
For the Rogues to attack us so close to Fort Bush... Ashcroft must really know something important.
Trent, I'm sorry I couldn't meet you as planned. I'm on assignment in California.
I can't tell you specifics right now. Let's just say Ashcroft provided us with the information we hoped for. Meet me on California Minor as soon as you can.
I'm already committed!
Mr. Trent! We need to talk.
Aaaaaaaahhh!
We've lost enough time here. The convoy is not gonna wait for us, Trent. We've gotta go.
That's it. You should have just told me that you're not interested in this mission. See ya!
column5: See ya! as the script has it

column3: Got it! Thank you, San Diego. Trent, we've got to hurry. Let's go.
Damn it! Transport 2 is down. We've got to get out of here!
Coolant leak! Our engine core is damaged. Get these guys off us!
Damn it, Trent! The lead transport is down. That's it. We failed.
Oh, I recommend you land and repair your ship. We'll meet back in space in a few minutes.

Switching to a secure channel... Something's terribly wrong. I wanted to brief my CO on what happened with the convoy, but he's been ordered to Manhattan. My contacts tell me that he's actually been placed under arrest – for treason! I tried to find out more, but all my friends at LSF Headquarters seemed to have disappeared. The only person I was able to contact was King, who's still on Pittsburgh.
They're opening fire! Engage!
Do you think this had anything to do with the artifacts? I just don't get it... Rheinland? Even if there's a traitor in the Liberty Military, what do Rheinlanders have to do with anything?
column5: kept exactly as typed

column3: After you called me from Willard, I started to ask around a bit. I confirmed that your CO is in prison. There's been a major shake-up in the higher ranks of the LSF.
What?! Rheinlanders?
Okay, I'll try to find out what's going on. Talk to you soon.
All fighter wings – engage the enemy. Cruisers! Break formation and protect Willard Station.
Got 'em!
Trent, this is Juni. Something's going on. I need your help. Meet me on Manhattan.
First to Fort Bush and then from there to the Badlands. If they find the bodies on the landing pad, the Navy will lock down all Trade Lanes. We have to hurry!
This is the Liberty Navy! Cut your engines and prepare to be taken into custody.
The Unity is blocking the entrance! We're surrounded!
Walker here! We'll take care of the battleship.

Code red! I repeat: Code red! This is the Battleship Unity! We are under attack and taking heavy casualties. In need of immediate assistance, all available units please approach sector Manhattan01_01, I repeat, please approach sector... [static]
Liberty Cruisers on an intercept course. Range: 10000m and closing. Projected intercept: 30 seconds.
We made it! The Badlands will shield us from their scanners. I don't think the Navy will follow us in here.
Damn it! That was close. I think we managed to shake 'em.
Negative, Benford! Target renegade ships, on my signal!
I'm picking up more incoming ships. Oh my – three cruisers are closing fast!
Doctor, you've got to come with us. We're coming in to pick you up.
Juni! [static] out of here! There's [static] –thing you can do. Save yourselves! I will– [static]
No! They'll pay for this.
Goodbye, Liberty... thanks old man...
Trent, there's a bounty on our head. They'll never let us out of here alive. We have to fight.
We've got to get out of here. EVERYBODY is looking for you. Uploading a waypoint to your Neural Net. Come with us!

It's best if we split up. With that price on our heads, every bounty hunter in the colonies is gonna be after us. I'll go to Cambridge to find Professor Quintaine. Trent, find your friend on Leeds and stay out of sight. I'm uploading the coordinates of the Leeds Jump Hole.

Trent! This is Juni. I've made it to Cambridge. No luck so far finding the Professor. I'll contact you when I hear anything. Until then, keep a low profile. Every bounty hunter in the colonies is probably looking for us.
Took you long enough! We don't have any time to waste. Let's go.

Incoming ships! Be advised: Rheinland forces have set up blockades in Omega-7. No ships are allowed access to Rheinland space. All merchant vessels are to remain at Freeport 1 until the crisis is over.
Negative! But Sprague lies beyond our patrol routes – if you are attacked, we won't be able to send help.
Understood. Thanks for the warning.
Vance gave me the frequency of the dig site beacon. I'm not picking up a signal yet... we probably have to get closer.
Break and attack!

column3: Those ships came out of nowhere! Looked like some kind of cloaking technology. Not even the Liberty Navy's ever managed to get these to work.
Never mind that! We're outnumbered! We've got to get out of here!
Baxter Research Station. It's been abandoned for over a decade, but life support should still be functioning.

Radar is clear. Nice fighting, but I'm sure there'll be more. We have to get to Trent's friend in Leeds. I'm sure the Jump Gate's being watched. Sinclair, what's your status? Any ideas how to get out of here?
I'm okay. There's a Jump Hole to Cambridge nearby. That's our best shot. From there, it should be easy to get to Leeds.

Doctor, ever since Trent came in possession of the artifact, we've been hunted. First by the Liberty Navy, then bounty hunters, now Rheinlanders. Everybody seems to be after it, and we don't even know what it is. A friend told us that Professor Quintaine might be able to shed some light on this.
We need to know what's going on with this artifact. Why everyone's after it.
Damn, I guess the best thing we can do is fly to Leeds and regroup.
We have to head to New London and from there to Leeds. I doubt the Rheinlanders will look for us here, but we need to stay sharp.
Damn it! They found us. Trent, engage.
STOP! Do not open fire! We mean you no harm. We're here to warn you.

Our wing was outfitted with cloaking devices – strange looking things, they're part of a secret Rheinland weapons program. We'll cloak ourselves before we reach the Jump Hole. They will think that you're an easy target, but we'll give them a little surprise.
Damn it. The Jump Hole is blocked by a battleship! What are we gonna do?
Have it your way! All fighter wings, engage. Target their engines–
We're hit! All hands, abandon ship. Repeat–
Ahhhhhhhhh!

column3: The Trade Lane to Leeds is near. We should go.
I like your attitude, Bretonian. It'll be a shame to see you burn. But hey, that's the price of sportsmanship.
That's it, kid! Deal's off!

'course, I don't; you hunk o' junk. I built this damn thing, but its memory banks are busted. Simple rules, Bretonian: one round, no shootin' or bumpin' – and if you stink it up or chicken out on the course, you'll make me angry! And you don't want that! You ready?
YEE HAW!

Ha ha! My grandma is faster than you, Bretonian!
Okay, I'll tell you want you want to know – but not over the comm channel. Meet me on the deck of the Hood.
This is your last warning. Surrender Quintaine or you will be destroyed.
Jarvis, Foshko: take out the gunship. Sanchez, Barrera: engage the fighters.
We got the gunship.
Mr. Trent, Quintaine here. I am flying this armored transport. I know it's slow, but it contains all the equipment I need for my work.
So Sinclair wants to meet on Leeds? That blight on our culture? All right.
Perez and Wallace, protect Quintaine. Mr. Trent, let's take down the gunship.
I actually haven't seen Dr. Sinclair in years. She sent me a message a while back that she had made a discovery on Pygar. Finally, a Dom'Kavash artifact that's still active...
Trent, no hard feelings!
Heheh, kiss your credits goodbye! Hovis hasn't lost in over a year.
He's gonna crush 'em!
All right, Hovis! Kick some ass!
I can't believe this!
I can't believe it!

column3: Beginner's luck!
Another five thousand on Hovis!
Ten thousand on the newbie!
I think the newcomer has a chance!
Come on Hovis, gun it!
Hah! This kid's got some skills. I like it, I like it!
I won! Look at all them there credits!
Another win for Hovis!
Mr. Trent, you have the coordinates to Leeds. Take point.
Wallace is down. It's looking grim.
Quintaine's ship can't take much more damage! Cover the transport!
Damn it, he cloaked! We've got to get away from here.
We're coming up on Stokes. Stay sharp.
Trent, Sinclair and Quintaine need enough time to get through the Gate. No matter what awaits us there – we have to buy them as much time as we can and then jump to Tau-31.
...emergency generators. This is Outpost Glasgow. To all Bretonian ships, we're under attack by a Rheinland strike force and have sustained heavy damage!
This is Outpost Glasgow to all Bretonian ships! We're under attack! Repeat: we are under attack!
Trent, a fleet of Rheinland ships is only minutes behind us. We have little time.
Destroy the fighters and let's get out of here!
We're coming up on Holman. Keep your eyes open. If there are Rheinlanders, we won't have the element of surprise this time.
The next Trade Lane takes us to the Tau-29 gate. From there, it's just a short flight to Shinkaku.
It's a trap! We only have one chance – quick, let's get out of here!
Hmm. The Tau-23 gate is not functional yet. Our best option is Planet Harris, but it's pretty far from here.
We cannot make it to Planet Harris from here... but there's an intermittent Jump Hole nearby. It might not work, but it's our only option. I'm uploading the coordinates!
Ha ha ha ha! We're not such easy prey after all, eh!
No! We have to leave the system. What's the status of the Jump Hole?
We're almost at Shinkaku.
Apparently, the Kress base is not far – it's in a secret location on the far side of this system. The bartender gave me a set of coordinates. I'm uploading them now.
All right everybody, let's get moving.
What did the bartender say about Kress?
Red Alert! The Schiller is hit! Man all turrets! All other fighters: engage enemy ships!
Our reactor is hit! We're losing containment! Ahhhhhhh!
Bullseye! All units engage! Hit 'em fast and hit 'em hard!
No time to explain, we're uploading coordinates. Professor, you and the freighter have to fly there as quickly as you can – we'll try to hold off the Rheinland fleet.
We have them on the run!
The bartender on Shinkaku contacted us. Kress immediately sent us to find you.
We should be safe now, but we need to keep moving. The Jump Hole to Tau-23 is near.

This is Quintaine. Kress managed to contact his agent, Lord Hakkera. He is waiting for you on planet Kyushu. Please contact me when you have the Proteus Tome. In the meantime, Sinclair and I will continue to study the artifact. Good luck.
It's funny – I used to fly around this asteroid field when I was younger. My grandmother lives on Tsushima station above Aso. I haven't been back here in over a decade.
Trent! It took a while, but I finally found what we're looking for. Meet me in the New Tokyo system. It's urgent.
The transport is still docking with Yukawa, Ozu-sensei, but it looked like they were about to leave. I counted multiple heavy weapon platforms and strong fighter protection. It won't be easy.
There is the shipyard. Is everybody ready?
The second platform is down! Ozu to strike team: Operation is a go! All ships, take out the escort fighters.
Another escort fighter destroyed! Hold on... I have a report from the strike team. They caught Tekagi's men off guard and have them pinned down.
To all ships! The strike team has successfully taken over the transport. Disengage and protect the transport.
